description: This file defines an abstract class CsvDataImport within the OrangeHRM project, specifically under the Core\Import namespace. The class serves as a base for CSV data import functionalities, requiring subclasses to implement an import method that processes an array of data and returns a boolean indicating success or failure.

classes.name: CsvDataImport
classes.description: An abstract class representing a CSV data import process that requires subclasses to implement the import method.

methods.name: import
methods.description: An abstract method that takes an array of data and returns a boolean indicating the success of the import process.
